title: Wii Menu
lede: Nintendo’s console home screen: a grid of rounded “channel” tiles on white, with pale-blue curves and round glossy buttons.
summary: Rounded white channel tiles and pale-blue curves. Nintendo Wii system menu, 2006.

creator.name: Nintendo (development led by Takashi Aoyama, Integrated Research & Development Division)

made: 2006 (the Wii launched in the United States on November 19, 2006)

evidence.note: Inspected the non-free 420 × 236 screenshot [File:Wiimen.png](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Wiimen.png) (Wii Menu after a system update) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored. The console was not used.

styles.note: Wikipedia and Avcı both name the Wii among the consoles that used the style; the menu shows its white, rounded, pale-blue side.

context: The Wii Menu was the Wii’s main interface. Development was led by Takashi Aoyama; the “channels” concept presented applications like a row of televisions in an electronics shop. The Wii launched with six channels, including the Forecast and News channels. [Wikipedia: Wii](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wii#Wii_Menu).

Wikipedia names “video game consoles such as the Wii” among the media that used Frutiger Aero. [Wikipedia: Frutiger Aero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frutiger_Aero). Avcı lists the Nintendo Wii with the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 as examples. [Avcı 2024, “Physical reflections of digital aesthetics”](https://doi.org/10.17932/IAU.EJNM.25480200.2024/ejnm_v8i3003), p. 461.

Dazed describes parents playing “virtual tennis on Wii Sports” as part of the era’s setting. [Holliday, Dazed, 2023](https://www.dazeddigital.com/life-culture/article/58103/1/what-is-frutiger-aero-aesthetic-tiktok-msn-messenger-windows-vista-noughties).
observed: Twelve rounded-rectangle tiles fill a light gray-white grid; empty tiles carry a faint embossed “Wii” mark.
The Forecast Channel tile is a saturated blue gradient; the News Channel tile is green with a globe.
A curved, pale-blue line separates the grid from a lower bar that holds a thin digital clock and the date.
Two round buttons sit at the lower corners: a “Wii” button and a mail envelope, each with a pale-blue rim.
interpretation: This is Frutiger Aero at its lightest: white and pale blue instead of deep glass, with gloss reduced to rims and tiles. It shows that the style can be calm and domestic, not only showy.
borrow: Use a white field with one curved pale-blue divider line to separate content from controls.
Make secondary actions round buttons with a colored rim and a soft inner highlight.

rights.statement: Nintendo software; copyrighted. No image is stored here.
